questions.learningObjective: Apply occupational prestige to a study of occupational prestige.

stimulus.body: A 2007 survey of 450 retirees in West Africa found 65% rated professional jobs as high prestige, while 33% rated manual jobs that way.

questions.stem: What is the point gap in the 2007 Africa occupational prestige survey?
questions.explanation: Subtracting 33 percent from 65 percent gives 32 percentage points, the gap reported in the 2007 data from West Africa between the two shares.
questions.hint: Look past the numbers to the relationship they describe.
